title: Handicap Index Goal Adherence by Season
dataSources: Golf rounds (`golf:round`), Garmin golf telemetry (`garmin:golf`), UDisc rounds (`udisc:round`), launch-monitor shots (`launchmonitor:shot`), handicap-index updates (`handicap:index`).
app: Arccos and Garmin S62 round telemetry, UDisc round exports, launch-monitor CSVs, and handicap-index updates streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted imports.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=handicap:index
| stats avg(handicap_index) as actual count as sessions by season
| eval pct_of_goal=round(100*12.0/actual,1), goal_label="12"
| sort pct_of_goal
description: Compares average handicap index with a simple target for each season, showing where handicap index is meeting plan and where it is lagging.
value: Splitting target adherence by season shows which contexts are helping you hit the plan and which ones need adjustment.
implementation: Set the target value in the query to match your routine, then review low-adherence season values before the next session block.
visualization: Table of season values with average handicap index and percent of goal.
grandmaExplanation: It gathers which season settings help you hit your target for handicap index and which ones fall short.
